::: {.callout-note}
## Rank Gap Analysis experiments

1. Upload `gap-analysis.csv` from the Gap Analysis workspace.
2. Set the scientific or operational impact and implementation effort for each metric.
3. Use the matrix to discuss Quick Wins and Strategic Projects with the team.
4. Export `prioritized-experiments.csv`, then save or move it to `output/` before importing it into Kaizen Experiments.
:::

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

viewof gap_experiment_prioritization = {
  const priority_state = {rows: []};
  const priority_root = document.createElement("div");
  priority_root.className = "priority-workspace";

  const priority_import_card = document.createElement("section");
  priority_import_card.className = "priority-card";
  const priority_import_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  priority_import_heading.textContent = "Experiment Prioritization & Ranking";
  const priority_import_help = document.createElement("p");
  priority_import_help.textContent =
    "Choose gap-analysis.csv exported from the Gap Analysis workspace. It remains only in this browser tab.";
  const priority_controls = document.createElement("div");
  priority_controls.className = "priority-controls";
  const priority_file_label = document.createElement("label");
  priority_file_label.textContent = "Gap Analysis CSV";
  const priority_file = document.createElement("input");
  priority_file.type = "file";
  priority_file.accept = ".csv,text/csv";
  priority_file_label.append(priority_file);
  priority_controls.append(priority_file_label);
  priority_import_card.append(priority_import_heading, priority_import_help, priority_controls);

  const priority_table_card = document.createElement("section");
  priority_table_card.className = "priority-card";
  const priority_table_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  priority_table_heading.textContent = "Impact vs. Effort scoring";
  const priority_table_help = document.createElement("p");
  priority_table_help.textContent =
    "Impact reflects scientific or operational value; effort reflects feasibility and implementation risk.";
  const priority_table_wrap = document.createElement("div");
  priority_table_wrap.className = "priority-table-wrap";
  const priority_table = document.createElement("table");
  priority_table.className = "priority-table";
  const priority_head = document.createElement("thead");
  const priority_head_row = document.createElement("tr");
  [
    "Process node", "Metric", "Baseline", "Target", "Gap status",
    "Scientific / Operational Impact", "Implementation Effort / Feasibility",
    "Priority score", "Priority"
  ].forEach((label) => {
    const heading = document.createElement("th");
    heading.scope = "col";
    heading.textContent = label;
    priority_head_row.append(heading);
  });
  priority_head.append(priority_head_row);
  const priority_body = document.createElement("tbody");
  priority_table.append(priority_head, priority_body);
  priority_table_wrap.append(priority_table);
  priority_table_card.append(priority_table_heading, priority_table_help, priority_table_wrap);

  const priority_chart_card = document.createElement("section");
  priority_chart_card.className = "priority-card";
  const priority_chart_heading = document.createElement("h2");
  priority_chart_heading.textContent = "Effort vs. Impact matrix";
  const priority_chart_help = document.createElement("p");
  priority_chart_help.textContent =
    "The upper-left quadrant highlights Quick Wins; the upper-right quadrant identifies Strategic Projects.";
  const priority_chart = document.createElement("div");
  priority_chart.className = "priority-chart";
  priority_chart_card.append(priority_chart_heading, priority_chart_help, priority_chart);

  const priority_export_card = document.createElement("section");
  priority_export_card.className = "priority-card";
  const priority_export = priority_button("Export Prioritized Experiments CSV");
  priority_export.disabled = true;
  const priority_export_help = document.createElement("span");
  priority_export_help.textContent =
    "Downloads prioritized-experiments.csv. Save or move it into output/ before importing it into Kaizen.";
  priority_export_card.append(priority_export, document.createTextNode(" "), priority_export_help);

  const priority_status = document.createElement("p");
  priority_status.className = "priority-status";
  priority_status.setAttribute("role", "status");
  priority_status.setAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
  priority_root.append(
    priority_import_card, priority_table_card, priority_chart_card,
    priority_export_card, priority_status
  );

  function priority_button(label) {
    const button = document.createElement("button");
    button.type = "button";
    button.textContent = label;
    return button;
  }

  function priority_parse_csv(text) {
    const rows = [];
    let row = [];
    let field = "";
    let quoted = false;
    for (let index = 0; index < text.length; index += 1) {
      const character = text[index];
      if (quoted) {
        if (character === "\"" && text[index + 1] === "\"") {
          field += "\"";
          index += 1;
        } else if (character === "\"") {
          quoted = false;
        } else {
          field += character;
        }
      } else if (character === "\"") {
        quoted = true;
      } else if (character === ",") {
        row.push(field);
        field = "";
      } else if (character === "\n") {
        row.push(field);
        rows.push(row);
        row = [];
        field = "";
      } else if (character !== "\r") {
        field += character;
      }
    }
    if (quoted) throw new Error("The CSV contains an unclosed quoted value.");
    if (field || row.length) rows.push([...row, field]);
    const headers = rows[0]?.map((header, index) =>
      (index === 0 ? header.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "") : header).trim()
    ) ?? [];
    const required = ["process_node", "metric", "baseline_value", "target_value", "percentage_improvement", "gap_status"];
    if (rows.length < 2 || required.some((column) => !headers.includes(column))) {
      throw new Error("Choose a gap-analysis.csv export containing process_node, metric, baseline_value, target_value, percentage_improvement, and gap_status.");
    }
    return rows.slice(1)
      .filter((values) => values.some((value) => value !== ""))
      .map((values) => Object.fromEntries(
        headers.map((header, index) => [header, values[index] ?? ""])
      ));
  }

  function priority_select(options, value, on_change) {
    const select = document.createElement("select");
    options.forEach(([score, label]) => {
      const option = document.createElement("option");
      option.value = score;
      option.textContent = label;
      select.append(option);
    });
    select.value = String(value);
    select.addEventListener("change", () => on_change(Number(select.value)));
    return select;
  }

  function priority_category(row) {
    if (row.impact_score >= 3 && row.effort_score <= 2) return "Quick Win";
    if (row.impact_score >= 3 && row.effort_score >= 3) return "Strategic Project";
    if (row.impact_score <= 2 && row.effort_score <= 2) return "Fill-In Task";
    return "Re-Evaluate";
  }

  function priority_badge(category) {
    const badge = document.createElement("span");
    badge.className = "priority-badge";
    badge.dataset.category = category;
    badge.textContent = ({
      "Quick Win": "🚀 Quick Win (High Priority)",
      "Strategic Project": "🎯 Strategic Project",
      "Fill-In Task": "🧹 Fill-In Task",
      "Re-Evaluate": "🛑 Re-Evaluate"
    })[category];
    return badge;
  }

  function priority_render_chart() {
    priority_chart.replaceChildren();
    if (!priority_state.rows.length) return;
    priority_chart.append(Plot.plot({
      height: 420,
      marginLeft: 60,
      marginBottom: 55,
      x: {domain: [0.5, 4.5], ticks: [1, 2, 3, 4], label: "Implementation Effort / Feasibility →"},
      y: {domain: [0.5, 4.5], ticks: [1, 2, 3, 4], label: "Scientific / Operational Impact →"},
      color: {
        domain: ["Quick Win", "Strategic Project", "Fill-In Task", "Re-Evaluate"],
        range: ["#198754", "#0d6efd", "#ffc107", "#dc3545"]
      },
      marks: [
        Plot.ruleX([2.5]), Plot.ruleY([2.5]),
        Plot.dot(priority_state.rows, {
          x: "effort_score", y: "impact_score", r: 9, fill: "priority_category",
          stroke: "#212529",
          title: (row) => `${row.process_node}: ${row.metric}\n${row.priority_category} (${row.priority_score})`
        }),
        Plot.text([
          {x: 1.5, y: 4.3, label: "Quick Wins"}, {x: 3.5, y: 4.3, label: "Strategic Projects"},
          {x: 1.5, y: 0.7, label: "Fill-In Tasks"}, {x: 3.5, y: 0.7, label: "Low Priority"}
        ], {x: "x", y: "y", text: "label", fill: "#495057"})
      ]
    }));
  }

  function priority_render() {
    priority_body.replaceChildren();
    priority_state.rows.forEach((row) => {
      row.priority_score = Number((row.impact_score / row.effort_score).toFixed(2));
      row.priority_category = priority_category(row);
      const table_row = document.createElement("tr");
      [
        row.process_node, row.metric, row.baseline_value, row.target_value, row.gap_status
      ].forEach((value) => {
        const cell = document.createElement("td");
        cell.textContent = value;
        table_row.append(cell);
      });
      const impact = document.createElement("td");
      impact.append(priority_select([
        [1, "Low (1)"], [2, "Medium (2)"], [3, "High (3)"], [4, "Critical (4)"]
      ], row.impact_score, (value) => {
        row.impact_score = value;
        priority_render();
      }));
      const effort = document.createElement("td");
      effort.append(priority_select([
        [1, "Easy / Low Effort (1)"], [2, "Moderate Effort (2)"],
        [3, "High Effort (3)"], [4, "Complex / High Risk (4)"]
      ], row.effort_score, (value) => {
        row.effort_score = value;
        priority_render();
      }));
      const score = document.createElement("td");
      score.textContent = String(row.priority_score);
      const category = document.createElement("td");
      category.append(priority_badge(row.priority_category));
      table_row.append(impact, effort, score, category);
      priority_body.append(table_row);
    });
    priority_render_chart();
    priority_export.disabled = priority_state.rows.length === 0;
    priority_root.dispatchEvent(new Event("input", {bubbles: true}));
  }

  function priority_csv_value(value) {
    return `"${String(value ?? "").replace(/"/g, "\"\"")}"`;
  }

  priority_file.addEventListener("change", async () => {
    try {
      const file = priority_file.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) throw new Error("Choose a gap-analysis.csv file smaller than 5 MB.");
      priority_state.rows = priority_parse_csv(await file.text()).map((row) => ({
        process_node: String(row.process_node).trim(),
        metric: String(row.metric).trim(),
        baseline_value: String(row.baseline_value).trim(),
        target_value: String(row.target_value).trim(),
        percentage_improvement: String(row.percentage_improvement).trim(),
        gap_status: String(row.gap_status).trim(),
        impact_score: 2,
        effort_score: 2,
        priority_score: 1,
        priority_category: "Fill-In Task"
      }));
      priority_render();
      priority_status.textContent = `Loaded ${priority_state.rows.length} metric gap${priority_state.rows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} for prioritization.`;
    } catch (error) {
      priority_state.rows = [];
      priority_render();
      priority_status.textContent = error.message;
    }
  });

  priority_export.addEventListener("click", () => {
    const columns = [
      "process_node", "metric", "baseline_value", "target_value", "percentage_improvement",
      "gap_status", "impact_score", "effort_score", "priority_score", "priority_category", "timestamp"
    ];
    const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
    const csv = [
      columns.join(","),
      ...priority_state.rows.map((row) =>
        columns.map((column) => priority_csv_value(column === "timestamp" ? timestamp : row[column])).join(",")
      )
    ].join("\n");
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([csv], {type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8"}));
    link.download = "prioritized-experiments.csv";
    link.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(link.href);
    priority_status.textContent = "Prioritized experiments CSV ready. Save or move prioritized-experiments.csv into output/.";
  });

  return priority_root;
}
```

## Prioritize the Acoustic Pipeline Gaps

Treat `gap-analysis.csv` as a structured decision guide rather than a rigid ranking list. Review the calculated metric variances with field technicians, acoustic analysts, software developers, and research scientists. Confirm each baseline, target, unit, source timestamp, and direction of improvement (e.g., lower lead times vs. higher %C&A accuracy) before committing development time or budget.

Use the gap status as an initial filter:

- **Critical Gap (red):** The proposed Future State target regresses compared to the baseline (or a higher-is-better metric drops). Re-examine the data inputs first, then address any confirmed performance regression.
- **Moderate Gap (yellow):** The target improves operational performance by less than 20%. Evaluate whether closing this remaining shortfall is critical to meeting management deadlines.
- **On Target (green):** The proposed target achieves an improvement of 20% or greater. Confirm that the target is realistic and that optimizing this step won't create a new downstream bottleneck.
- **Not calculated:** A metric value is missing, non-numeric, or has a zero baseline. Resolve the data gap before ranking.

Status alone does not dictate scientific priority. Give weight to gaps that directly impact:
* **Regulatory & Management Mandates:** Datasets tied to marine mammal stock assessment deadlines or biological opinions.
* **Analyst Capacity:** High-volume visual/auditory inspection tasks causing multi-month backlogs.
* **Data Integrity & Risk:** Raw acoustic files residing on unbacked-up physical media or field drives.
* **Downstream Delivery:** Metadata errors blocking archival ingest into national repositories (e.g., NCEI).

---

## Turn an Acoustic Gap into a Kaizen Experiment

Each prioritized gap serves as the foundation for a focused, small-scale test in the **Kaizen Experiments** workspace:

1. **Target Gap:** Identify the specific process node (e.g., *AI Detection*, *Glider Telemetry Sync*), metric, baseline, and target from `gap-analysis.csv`.
2. **PAM Hypothesis:** Formulate a testable prediction (e.g., *"Integrating a pre-trained deep-learning model for baleen whale call pre-screening will reduce analyst validation time by 50% without dropping call recall below 90%"*).
3. **Action Items:** Define the smallest safe pilot test (e.g., run the model on 2 cruise legs before scaling program-wide).
4. **Owner:** Assign a lead bioacoustician or data engineer to manage the test and evaluate results.
5. **Success Metric:** Use the gap metric (e.g., $PT$ in hr/TB or First-Pass %C&A) to define success criteria and measurement timelines.
6. **Queue & Priority:** Rank the experiment based on scientific impact, compute availability, analyst bandwidth, and deployment schedules.

---

## Check the Handoff

- [ ] Validate high-priority baselines, targets, units, and directional statuses with process owners and analysts.
- [ ] Ensure "higher-is-better" metrics (e.g., AI accuracy, schema compliance) are correctly interpreted.
- [ ] Confirm that selected gaps directly address major processing bottlenecks or management deadlines.
- [ ] Save or move `gap-analysis.csv` into `output/`.
- [ ] Carry each prioritized gap forward into the Kaizen Experiments workspace with a defined hypothesis, owner, pilot action items, and success metrics.

::: {.callout-note}
If a baseline or target value requires adjustment, update and re-export the Current or Future State metadata before repeating the comparison.
